title: Injectivity of the code-to-matching map
statement: Let $q,k$ be natural numbers such that $k>0$ and $qk$ is even. The map sending a code for a perfect matching on $qk$ vertices whose decoded edges join different parts to the corresponding perfect matching of the complete $q$-partite graph with $k$ vertices in each part is injective.
